EC1: Exclusion criteria include patients following resuscitation from cardiac arrest who are treated on the cooling protocol
EC2: patients who have suffered a neurologic event (seizure [OR], stroke) [OR]  or who have baseline dementia, both of which could limit delirium assessment
EC3: patients with child class [AND] B [OR] and C liver disease
EC4: patients with known allergy [AND] to study medications.
